settings: clean committed resources; only map_seed changed before scene starts
driver_difference: Current driver adds optional no_dodge control and shield reporting; default reactive decisions are unchanged. Original source retained in driver-v4.gd.txt.
observability_limits: Automated input uses exact enemy windup state, not human reaction.
Planner knows region bounds and facility rules; resource targets require discovery.
Per-tick total pouch plus ground deltas are net changes. Opposing income and expenditure within one tick can cancel; these are not gross revenue/cost totals.
Raw matrix fields crystals_generated/crystals_spent are historical names for those observed net increases/decreases.
Events mark controller errand completion/interruption, not authoritative purchase receipts.
No OS install, touch hardware, audio/visual or human fun validation is established by these headless runs.
